Zcash NU7 upgrade deployment spec finalized, ZEC drops 5.3–10.5% same-day –
Link
The Zcash Foundation released Zebra 7.0.0 node software and finalized the NU7 activation height at block 3,543,405, expected around Nov. 5–6. The upgrade will cut block times from 75 to 25 seconds, but ZEC still sold off hard on the day.
The upgrade is positive for the network, but near-term price can still lag if the asset is already overextended and profit-taking dominates.

Cross-chain swaps now settle in under 1 second.
According to the team:
• 21–46% faster swaps
• 0.5% better execution on average
• Over 2% improvement for the worst-performing 10% of trades
Fomo previously relied on Relay for cross-chain transfers. It now has its own bridge and routing infrastructure.
